headlines.text: Looking back to 2026, when MJF vs. Kenny Omega fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynasty, rated 8.52 ? a genuine showstealer. It marked MJF's 20th match with the title on the line. In a near 40-minute war involving two referees, a table, and nearly half a dozen V-Triggers, MJF used the Dynamite Diamond Ring to turn back Kenny Omega and retain the AEW World Title.

2025 brought us this moment: Konosuke Takeshita vs. Brody King met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, in the show-closing main event slot on Collision, rated 8.17 ? a fantastic contest. Takeshita, notably without Don Callis at ringside, overcame Brody King's chops with a deadlift wheelbarrow slam and running knee strikes to advance in the Owen Hart Cup.
That Friday in 2024, Zak Knight kicked off their AEW journey against Angelo Parker, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.62.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2023, when the AEW International Title was up for grabs as Orange Cassidy vs. Buddy Matthews went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.75 ? a solid showing.

On a Sunday in 2026, back when a new champion was crowned for the AEW TNT Title as Kevin Knight vs. Anthony Bowens vs. Bandido vs. Daniel Garcia vs. El Clon vs. Mike Bailey vs. PAC vs. Rush vs. Tommaso Ciampa vs. Wheeler Yuta battled it out in a Casino Gauntlet match, appearing on Dynasty, rated 7.52 ? a well-worked match ? ending the champion's reign at 1 defense. It was the 130th time the AEW TNT Title had been on the line, a real piece of championship history. In a wild Casino Gauntlet for the vacant TNT Title at Dynasty, Kevin Knight outlasted a murderers' row that included Ciampa, Rush, Bandido, Bailey, El Clon, PAC, Garcia, Bowens and Yuta to walk out champion.

Flash back to 2026, when Jon Moxley vs. Will Ospreay clashed for the AEW Continental Title, appearing on Dynasty, rated 8.55 ? a war that left everything in the ring. Moxley survived a returning Will Ospreay's onslaught to retain the Continental Title, only for Ospreay to turn on the Death Riders afterward, still hunting revenge for the neck injury that had sidelined him.
